module: Node "Template Node": documented example of everything a programmer can use to create a flowgraph node. Shows the possible categories (repeat_instant, repeat_p_duration, repeat_f_duration, once_instant, once_p_duration, once_f_duration, dynamic_*, simple, provider, logic), all pin types (flow, number, bool, string, vec3, quat, color, table, any, multi-type), pin options (default, hidden, hardcoded, tableType), C.todo, C.dependencies, C.color, C.type, C.tags and the lifecycle functions. Each function just displays a message with print. Useful as a template for a modder.
notes: In _onDeserialized, myField stays nil if the old record did not have this field, which would make im.ArrayChar fail in drawCustomProperties.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Called when the node is first created; initializes myField, the data table and the sliderWidth cursor.

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the project starts, before any work.

work.desc: Called when the node must run its function.

_onClear.desc: Called when the node must be cleaned up (before serialization, before start...); by default calls _executionStopped.

showProperties.desc: Called when the node's properties are displayed.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Imgui code displayed in the properties window (text field and slider); returning a string creates a history point (undo/redo).

hideProperties.desc: Called when the properties are no longer displayed.

drawMiddle.desc: Imgui code displayed in the node; must start with builder:Middle().

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the custom fields in res (self.data is saved automatically).

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the custom fields (self.data is restored automatically).

destroy.desc: Called when the node is deleted.
